Even as national media coverage of it ebbed since last year, Donald Trump's
"[Murder Inc](https://zeteo.com/p/murder-inc)." at sea never stopped. As of
[last month](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/u-s-kills-3-in-strike-in-
pacific-ocean-on-alleged-drug-boat), the Trump-Vance administration is still
conducting its ([almost certainly criminal](https://zeteo.com/p/second-strike-
all-of-the-us-strikes)) lethal [bombing campaign](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-
hegseth-admin-lawyers-warn-boat-strike-illegal) against supposed
"narcoterrorist" drug boats. The killing spree shows no sign of abating.

Sources familiar with the situation tell **Zeteo** that President Trump wants
more of them and has talked to key officials in recent weeks about expanding
operations. He still goes over menus of different plans and boat routes to
target. He and his administration keep propagandizing about how they're
winning this war, making the U.S. safer, saving [tens of thousands of
lives](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/fact-checking-trumps-claim-that-
each-boat-strike-off-venezuelas-coast-saves-25000-lives) per strike, and
keeping illicit narcotics off of American streets, all without [actually
knowing who they're killing](https://theintercept.com/2025/10/31/trump-
venezuela-boat-strikes-unprivileged-belligerants/).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

But the bombings aren't just illegal or wrong. According to U.S. intel and
government data described to **Zeteo** by several American officials and
others familiar with the situation, the killing also isn't working. At all.
And the White House knows this.
